LESSON: PHYSICAL ASPECT OF YOGA

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Yoga (Holistic Wellness)
Topic 6.1: Physical Aspect of Yoga

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Physical Aspect of Yoga. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why are Asanas important in performin g Yoga?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify Pranayam and Asanas for physical well- being
2. describe the types of Pranayam and Asanas for familiarisation
3. appreciate the importance of Pranayam and Asanas for healthy living
4. explain appropriate behaviours while using the road for safety
5. demonstrate a simple meditation technique for spiritual growth
6. describe examples of righteousness from Jain and Sikh Scriptural stories
7. explain the significance of celebrating the three selected festivals for traditional upkeep

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: PHYSICAL ASPECT OF YOGA
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 5
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Physical Aspect of Yoga helps you succeed in HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: PHYSICAL ASPECT OF YOGA
Study Physical Aspect of Yoga like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Identify Pranayam and Asanas for physical well- being

What this means
In this part you learn to identify Pranayam and Asanas for physical well- being. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: identify Pranayam and Asanas for physical well- being.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Physical Aspect of Yoga” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can identify Pranayam and Asanas for physical well- being. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Physical Aspect of Yoga is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Physical Aspect of Yoga” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: identify Pranayam and Asanas for physical well- being)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Physical Aspect of Yoga in your own words. (skill: describe the types of Pranayam and Asanas for familiarisation)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate the importance of Pranayam and Asanas for healthy living)

Example 4: Show how “Physical Aspect of Yoga” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: explain appropriate behaviours while using the road for safety)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Physical Aspect of Yoga to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: identify Pranayam and Asanas for physical well- being.
3. Practise this skill: describe the types of Pranayam and Asanas for familiarisation.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the importance of Pranayam and Asanas for healthy living.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Physical Aspect of Yoga from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Physical Aspect of Yoga: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 5 learner study Physical Aspect of Yoga?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why are Asanas important in performin g Yoga?
2. How does Pranayam help in physical wellbeing ?
3. How do communal aspects of Yoga benefit society?
4. How is meditation helpful in spiritual growth?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Physical Aspect of Yoga means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: identify Pranayam and Asanas for physical well- being.
5. Be able to: describe the types of Pranayam and Asanas for familiarisation.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
